name: Event Storming Modeler
description: Open .storm files as Event Storming boards: model with stickies, notes and arrows, and see an agent's changes to the file as they happen.

cover.alt: Miragon Modeler for Event Storming: Event Storming boards from plain .storm files, edited by you and your agents.
